tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Rate quoted should be inclusive of all taxes
Bidder has to quote their rates in terms of percentage only

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last three years i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26 Satisfactory completed as 3rd party consultant, Carried out anyone similar kind of projects like Total Supervision with Quality and Quantity Assurance (PMC)/3rd party inspection of projects/ works Cost of not less than Rs 87.50 crores in any one project in any one Year to any Govt departments, boards, PSUs etc

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last three years i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26 Satisfactory completed as 3rd party consultant, for Quality and Quantity Assurance/3rd party inspection consultancy (PMC) fees of not less than Rs 63.25 lakhs as consultant in any one project in any one year, to any Govt departments, boards, PSUs etc

Valid Registration Certificate from any of the below-mentioned authorities: a) National Assessment & Accreditation Council (NACC) certificate if the tenderer is a Govt Engineering college/ Govt IIT/ Govt IISC/ Govt Polytechnic College etc., 2) Valid PWD Empanelment Certificate
The consultant should have his own NABL certified lab and recent calibration

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last three years i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26 achieved in at least two financial years an average financial turnover of not less than Rs 250.00 Lakhs

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should produce a Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than 37.95 Lakhs Credit lines/ letters of credit/ certificates from Nationalized/Scheduled Commerical Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.( Banker Certificate in prescribed format provided in bid document, Conditional Banker Certificate is Not acceptable & Certificate should be taken after the date of Tender Published date)
Own or leased fully equipped Quality Analysis Mobile Laboratory (Vehicle Registration Certificate and fitness certificate to be enclosed)
The tenderer/firms/individuals should have registered with Labour Department (Labour License).

Key Personnel and Staff Requirements a) Team Leader (No. of Employees Required- Minimum 01) (Qualification required M Tech in CT/Transportation) (Minimum work Experience required is 10 Years) b)Engineer (Civil)(No. of Employees Required- Minimum 10) (Qualification required BE Civil and preference will be given to those having experience in QC/QA) (Minimum work Experience required is 5 Years) c)Engineer (Electrical)(No. of Employees Required- Minimum 01)(Qualification required BE Electrical / E&E)(Minimum work Experience required is 5 Years) d) Engineer (Mechanical/Automobile)(No. of Employees Required- Minimum 01)(Qualification required BE Mechanical/ Automobile)(Minimum work Experience required is 5 Years) e) Engineer (Environmental) (No. of Employees Required- Minimum 01) (Qualification required BE Environment Science or Chemical Engineering)(Minimum work Experience required is 5 Years) f) Support Engineer (Civil) (No. of Employees Required- Minimum 09) (Qualification required Diploma in Civil and preference will be given to those having experience in QC/QA) (Minimum work Experience required is 3 Years)
